title: Riley pattern in inhabited atmosphere
mutation_directive: wrap-the-print-in-a-real-room: parchment gradient + paper-grain + window light + dust motes
concept: Direct response to user feedback on 2g4 / 6mk: 'interesting direction but white flat background a bit plain. think holistically and keep making and evolving.' Same Riley-wave-interference field on a cupped (calyx) surface as 6mk — but the piece is now a complete environment, not a form on flat paper. The page background is a parchment radial-gradient with subtle vignette; an SVG-turbulence noise layer (multiply blend) gives paper grain; a CSS radial-gradient screen-blend simulates warm window-light from upper-left; a 250-mote additive dust layer catches that light. The Riley-form sits in the room rather than on a clean page.
